name: Gasthof Jägerwirt
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated on the forest edge in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, Gasthof Jaegerwirt treats guests to cosy rooms and delicious regional specialties. It provides a peaceful haven for hikers and outdoor enthusiasts.

Lake Hintersteiner See, mountain trails, and the SkiWelt cable cars are reachable in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: The traditional Gasthof Jaegerwirt in Scheffau offers authentic Tyrolean inn hospitality at the base of the Wilder Kaiser.
